note: Prompt grid for auditioning the suomisoundi DoRA arms (WINTERMUTE, 2026-08-18, to Kim's spec via C: 'replace HALF of the usual full-set prompts with ones suitable for suomisoundi'). 9 of the 18 standard matrix prompts are KEPT VERBATIM, ids and seeds included, so those cells are directly comparable against every other model on the board. 9 are replaced with suomisoundi prompts. Same steps/duration as the standard snapshot for the same reason.
kept_from_standard: trig2, housestyle, kimlong, techno, rb_common_1, rb_mid_3, rb_rare_6, kl_0, kl_1 -- chosen as CONTROLS rather than favourites: the trigger word, Kim's own two style references, and a spread of genre-distance probes from adjacent (goa, tech trance) to far (techno/house) to out-of-domain (jazz-fusion prose). If the arms have overfitted, kl_1 and rb_rare_6 are where it shows.
suomisoundi_prompt_design: Grounded in what the arms were ACTUALLY TRAINED ON, not invented: the t2 tier is 45% of training samples and its tag vocabulary measured over all 1260 tracks is led by hypnotic (1241), suomisoundi (1144), immersive (578), psychedelic (566), arpeggiated leads (469), euphoric (454), trance-inducing (385). BPM median 143, p25 143, p75 150, full range 77-188 -- so 143 is the corpus centre and 128/155 probe the edges. ss_anchor is the t1 string VERBATIM (25% of samples saw exactly it, so it is the strongest single handle we have); ss_trigger tests whether the bare word alone carries the style; ss_prose tests the t3 register (30% of samples). Decades ARE legitimate here unlike goa -- suomisoundi t2 mentions 2000s on 358 tracks and 2020s on 156, so the corpus genuinely spans them.
